findings.issue: fetch has no timeout or AbortSignal, so a slow/hung upstream API hangs page loads with no error surface
findings.suggestion: Use AbortSignal.timeout(10_000) (Node 24 supports it) and let the ApiError path render the existing +error.svelte fallback

findings.issue: Local state synced from load data inside $effect (same pattern at app/src/routes/team/+page.svelte:13) is fragile if data ever refreshes independently of navigation, and it's duplicated across routes
findings.suggestion: Wrap the stateful region in a {#key data.pokemon.name} block, or extract a small useRouteState helper shared by both pages

findings.issue: Default-variety resolution (varieties.find(is_default) plus pokemon/<id> fallback) is duplicated at line 359
findings.suggestion: Extract a resolveDefaultPokemon(species) helper next to the ApiSpecies type

findings.issue: Debounced search timer isn't cancelled when the user clicks a pagination link first, so a pending goto can pull them back to page 1
findings.suggestion: Clear the timer in an onbeforenavigate hook or check the current URL/page before applying the pending update

findings.issue: Team updates bypass SvelteKit's cookie handling via raw document.cookie (no framework round-trip or progressive enhancement)
findings.suggestion: Acceptable as-is, but a form action with cookies.set() would give no-JS support; at minimum note the trade-off in the comment

findings.issue: Single 370-line module shapes data for all five page types; fine today, but it's the file every future feature will touch
findings.suggestion: Split into per-resource modules (species/pokemon, moves, abilities, types) sharing api.ts when the next feature lands

findings.issue: Dynamically-composed var(--type-<name>) colour lookup re-implemented here instead of reusing TypeBadge's variant
findings.suggestion: Add a size/variant prop to TypeBadge (or a shared CSS mixin) so the colour-mapping lives in one place

findings.issue: Non-standard <meta name="text-scale" content="scale"> tag with no consumer
findings.suggestion: Remove it, or document why it's needed

summary: This is a genuinely current, idiomatic SvelteKit 3 codebase — runes, Snippets, server-only #lib/server boundaries, URL-driven state, and error()-based 404s all read like the framework's own docs, and the team feature slots into the existing conventions with minimal diff. The data layer is defensive (promise-dedup cache, sanitized cookie parsing, bounded caches) with only minor risks: no fetch timeout and a small search/pagination debounce race. I'd merge after a light pass fixing the timeout and two or three small duplications.
